Commentary.Commentary: So that is it from Wednesday's double-header. But the action continues as Thursday brings another double-header wherein first up India take on New Zealand that game begins at 1500 local (0400 GMT). After that hosts Australia take on Bangladesh which begins at 1900 local (0800 GMT). Till then take care and cheers!

Pakistan skipper, Bismah Maroof says she is very happy and they wanted to win this game to get the momentum going. States they managed to pick wickets at regular intervals and the new ball bowlers bowled well up front and they managed to keep them down to a low score which the batters did well to chase. She feels they are smart cricketers and they need to stick to their strengths. Ends by saying it is a very important victory and she hopes they can do well going ahead.

West Indies skipper, Stafanie Taylor says they did not have enough runs on the board. Mentions they under-performed with the bat and they should have got above 150. States the batters need to take the responsibility and pace their innings well and also rotate their strike nicely. Admits that is where they are lacking. Further adds the bowling has been terrific in the last couple of months especially the pacers. Ends by saying the Pakistan team though was exceptional but they will try and improve and come stronger in the next game.

PLAYER OF THE MATCH, Javeria Khan, humbly says that Diana deserves it more than she does but she is happy she got it and is pleased with how she and her team performed. States they are working hard and it paid off here. Mentions the wicket played well under lights and it was easier to bat. Informs that she was looking to take the attack to the bowlers and make it easier for the batters coming in.

The Windies bowling was poor to begin with! They leaked far too many runs which made the job for the Pakistan batters easy during the middle overs where there were a few good overs bowled. However, they needed wickets at regular intervals which they failed to take. Overall, it was a very under par performance by the Windies.

An excellent chase from Pakistan has seen them win their first game of this year's World Cup. To be honest, it is their bowlers who have to be credited for this win as they did really well to restrict West Indies to a small but a competitive total. However, Pakistan openers got them off to a very good start as they added 58. They though lost both the openers in quick succession. S kipper, Maroof and Nida, though accounted for a match-winning stand which took them over the line.
FOUR! That is it. The skipper scores the winning runs. It is bowled wide outside off, Maroof strokes it through covers and fetches a boundary. PAKISTAN WIN BY 8 WICKETS!
Short ball and Dar pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
On a good length and on off, Maroof drives it towards mid on.
Length ball on off, Maroof tucks it to the leg side and gets a couple.
Length ball on off, driven to covers.

DROPPED! Easiest of the chances put down. Dar picks the length ball early and slog it through the line towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder there gets to the ball, gets her hand to it but fumbles and allows a single.
Length ball on off, driven to covers.
Length ball on off, Dar looks to slog it to the leg side but gets beaten to get hit high on the pads.
Length ball on the pads, tucked towards the leg side for a single.

FOUR! Dar is lucky there as the inside edge does not go onto hit the stumps. Dar looks to go over the fence on the leg side this time on this full ball but ends up getting an inside edge which runs past the stumps and into the fence at fine leg for a boundary.
NO BALL! Connell bowls a high full toss and Maroof fails to lay bat on ball. The ball rolls towards third man for a single. Byes given. Free Hit coming up.
Full and on the pads, flicked towards mid-wicket for a couple.
Short of a length ball on off, Dar punches it towards covers for a single.
Another ball that is full on off, Maroof taps it towards the off side for a single.
Full and on middle, flicked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Loopy ball and around off, this is stroked towards cover where the fielder fumbles, a single is taken.
Was Matthews trying to mankad Nida? Well, it did seem so, she stopped on her run-up and had a look back. Did not do it, maybe just a warning.
Shorter and around off, this is pushed through covers for one.
On middle, this is nudged around the corner for one. Singles will do the job for Pakistan.
FOUR! That should have been stopped! On the pads, it is swept fine on the leg side. The fielder at short fine leg runs to her left, dives but lets it through. This could be a costly misfield.
On the pads, it is worked through square leg for one.
FOUR! Short and on middle, Maroof pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Tossed up outside off, Dar drives it towards mid off for a single.
Floated outside off, Dar looks to sweep but misses it.

NOT OUT! Floated ball on leg, Maroof sweeps towards short fine leg for a single. The fielder scores a direct hit and the umpire takes it upstairs. The replays show that Nida Dar made her ground there.
Run Out check sent upstairs! Nida Dar is in question but she looks safe there.
Floated ball outside off, Maroof skips down the track and chips in the air towards sweeper cover for a couple.
Flatter outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Taylor is back on!

FOUR! Not off the middle but Pakistan will take it! Out comes the reverse sweep. It hits the glove and goes fine on the off side. The short third man fielder gives it a chase and according to her she has pulled it back but it was quite clear she did not. The umpire spots it and signals the boundary. 36 needed in 36.
Another single as this is eased down to long off.
Confusion but safe! Shorter and around off, this is pushed towards cover. The non-stiker wants a run but is sent back by her partner. The fielder luckily fumbles and no harm is done.
Way too far outside off, wided.
On the pads, it is worked through square leg for one.
On middle, this is dragged through mid-wicket for one.
A full toss on middle, it is hit down to long on for one.
Outside off, it is left alone.
A single now as this is hit down to long off for one.
Maroof comes down the track and Taylor bowls it very full. It is jammed back out to the bowler.
Shorter and outside off, it is cut to point.
Nicely played but for no runs! On middle, Maroof goes down on one knee and nails the sweep but straight to the backward square leg fielder.
On middle, it is hit down to long on for one.
Tossed up on the pads, tucked to the leg side for a single.
Nida Dar walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Both the openers are gone. Fletcher bowls cleverly here. She tosses one up on middle, Ali goes for the flick but closes the bat face early to get a leading edge towards short cover. Anisa Mohammed there takes the catch and celebrates.

Floated and on the pads, Ali goes for the sweep but fails to middle it as the ball hits the pads and rolls to the leg side. The batsmen take a run but a wild throw from the keepr there means an extra run. Leg byes given.
Full and on middle, Maroof drives it to mid on for a single.
Tossed up on leg, tucked towards fine leg for a single.
Floated on the pads, swept to square leg.
Afy Fletcher is back on!
The batsman drives this through the covers. One run added to the total.
The batsman has punched that ball through the offside.

DROPPED! But that is a brilliant effort! Ali shuffles right across and looks to play the sweep shot. She hits it nicely towards backward square leg. The fielder there dives to her left, gets two hands to it but spills it. It goes towards fine leg for two. Would have been a brilliant catch. You need such chances to stick while defending a low score.
A single now as this is hit down towards long off.
Bismah comes down the track and also makes room. She carves it behind point on the off side for two.
On middle, it is pushed back to the bowler.
OHHH! This is floated up around leg stump. The batter looks to sweep but misses. It was close to the leg pole.
Anisa Mohammed is on now!
Maroof comes down the track, it is a low full toss. She eases it to long on for one. 59 needed in 60 balls now.
The batter charges down the wicket and pushes it towards cover.
Ali comes down the track and strokes it towards long off for one.
One more dot! Outside off, Muneeba looks to sweep but misses.
Well fielded! Such efforts can make a difference. On the pads, it is swept towards short fine where the fielder dives to her left and saves three for her side.
On middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket.
Down the leg side, Bismah looks to sweep but misses. Wided.
On middle, this is pushed towards covers for one more run. Back-to-back good overs for the Windies.
Around off, this is guided towards point.
Another single as this is eased down to long off for one.
On off, this time it is played towards cover for one.
Direct hit and Muneeba was a goner! This is guided towards point. Muneeba wants a run but is sent back. The fielder picks the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end but luckily for Ali, she misses.
On middle, this is pushed towards the bowler.
Maroof is off the mark as she dances down and strokes it through covers for one.
The batsman dances down the track and does well to block the ball.
Outside off, Maroof looks to guide it down to third man but misses.
On middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
Bismah Maroof is out to bat now.

OUT! There is the breakthrough the Windies so desperately needed! It is absolutely plumb in front. Taylor floats it up on middle, Khan looks to sweep but misses to get hit right in front. An appeal and up goes the finger. Windies though need a couple more quickly. 67 more needed in 76 balls.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Stefanie Taylor is on now!
FOUR ! Floated ball on the pads, Khan sweeps it through mid-wicket for a boundary.

An appeal for caught behind but nothing from the umpire there. West Indies too don't opt for the review. Khan lines up to play the sweep shot but gets beaten as the ball balloons off the arm towards the keeper. The keeper does well to collect it.
FOUR! Floated ball on off, Javeria dances down the track and lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
Full and on off, pushed  towards point for single.
Another flatter one on middle, Ali pulls it to find mid-wicket.
Flatter and on leg, Ali looks to pull it but gets it off the thigh pad towards the keeper.
Afy Fletcher is on now!

Deft! Brilliantly played! Outside off, JK waits for it and guides it through short third man. The fielder runs behind it, slides and saves two for her side. Excellent Powerplay for Pakistan. They are 48 for 0 after it. More 77 needed in 84.
The batter has played it towards mid-wicket.
On off, kept out.
Slower through the air and on off, it is worked towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! The boundaries are flowing here! It is short and on the body, Khan goes back and pulls it behind square on the leg side and it races away.
Flatter and on middle, it is pushed down to long on for one.
Hayley Matthews is on now!
FOUR! Another boundary! Huge over this! Just the 87 needed in 91. A low full toss on off, it is creamed through covers.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
FOUR! An excellently controlled cut shot! Short and outside off, Javeria gets on top of the bounce and plays it over the point fielder for a boundary.
FOUR! Slightly short and around middle, Khan gets low into position quickly. She pulls it over mid-wicket and bags a boundary. She picked the length early there.
Short and wide outside off, this is cut but straight to point.
Back of a length and on off, the batter drops it towards cover. A dot.
Down the leg side, the batter looks to flick but misses. Wided.
Chinelle Henry is on now!
FOUR! One more good over for Pakistan! This is full and wide outside off. It is carved behind point on the off side. 97 needed in 96 balls.

Overthrow! This is very good cricket from Pakistan! First Ali plays this slower ball nicely. She drops it on the off side for one. Then the fielder there makes a poor throw which the keeper fails to collect and they steal another run.
Just short again! On middle, JK looks to flick but it goes off the inner half towards mid-wicket. It bounces just ahead of the fielder and there is a fumble. A single taken.
On the shorter side and on the body, this is pulled through square leg for one.
Back of a length and on off, this is guided towards point.
Shorter in length and outside off, Khan cuts it through point for one.
On middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket. Pakistan are off to a good start.
FOUR! Very clever shot this! It is short and around off, Ali upper cuts it over the slip cordon and it races away to the fence. Good smart batting. Just used the pace of the bowler.
Just short! Ali comes down the track but she is cramped for room as it is bowled close to her body. She looks to swing but the ball hits the splice and lobs but falls just short of cover.
Full and outside off, it is driven nicely through covers for one.
On a length and around off, this is pushed towards mid off for one.
Outside off, Khan looks to drive but gets an outside edge down to third man for one.
Length ball on off, defended off the back foot to the off side.
Short of a length ball on off, Khan cuts it towards point and gets to the other end.
Good length and on middle, Javeria drives it this time to mid on.
Length ball on off, Khan drives it to find the fielder at covers.
Length ball on the pads, Khan flicks it to mid-wicket and gets a couple.
Length ball outside off, Javeria looks to go through the off side but ends up getting an outside edge that rolls towards the keeper.
WIDE! Length ball but down the leg side, Javeria misses her flick to be called a wide.
A single towards cover to end the first over. Good one for Pakistan.
FOUR! First boundary of the chase! This is short and outside off, Khan cuts but the ball goes off the outside edge and down to the third man fence.
The batsman goes after this one but misses the line completely. Wide signalled by the umpire.
One more short ball around off, JK cuts but finds point.
WIDE! Way too far outside off, Khan looks to cut but misses. Wided.
Shorter and around off, it is slapped hard but straight to point.
Pakistan are underway! A little too straight. Ali looks to defend but it goes off the inner half towards square leg for one.
Back of a length and on off, it is kept out.
We are back for Pakistan's reply. Javeria Khan and Muneeba Ali will open the innings for them. West Indies players are out too. Shamilia Connell with the ball first up.
